assessment.nobel_worthiness: Nd-Fe-B magnets transformed permanent-magnet technology and underpin much modern electrification and energy technology.
assessment.attribution: Sagawa and Croat receive clear credit for the practical discovery and development of the decisive Nd-Fe-B magnet materials.
assessment.maturity: The materials, their microscopic basis, and their immense technological impact have been established over decades.
uncertainties: The respective priority and scope of independent contributions require careful historical review.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Giant tunnel magnetoresistance made spin-dependent tunnelling a powerful physical effect and enabled important magnetic-memory technologies.
assessment.attribution: Miyazaki and Moodera established the early experimental effect, while Yuasa made essential later advances in coherent high-performance junctions.
assessment.maturity: The effect is reproducible, quantitatively understood, and central to mature spintronics.
uncertainties: The boundary between discovery of the effect and subsequent materials optimization needs precise attribution.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dynamical mean-field theory gave correlated-electron physics a broadly predictive framework connecting microscopic models with real materials.
assessment.attribution: Vollhardt and Kotliar initiated the formal method, and Georges was pivotal in establishing its conceptual and practical power.
assessment.maturity: It is a mature, extensively benchmarked method with deep influence on theory and interpretation of spectra.
uncertainties: The award would need to distinguish the core DMFT invention from later cluster and ab initio extensions.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical lattice clocks combine a decisive advance in precision measurement with broad consequences for timekeeping, metrology, and fundamental tests.
assessment.attribution: Katori introduced the magic-wavelength lattice-clock concept, and Ye made foundational experimental realizations and advances.
assessment.maturity: Independent laboratories now achieve extraordinary reproducibility and performance, with applications emerging clearly.
uncertainties: The division of credit among foundational clock and frequency-comb developments requires review.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: X-ray free-electron lasers opened an exceptional new regime of coherent ultrafast X-ray science, including direct access to matter on atomic scales.
assessment.attribution: The named researchers made complementary theoretical, accelerator, and realization contributions to the XFEL concept and its development.
assessment.maturity: Multiple facilities have demonstrated a durable scientific revolution across physics, chemistry, and structural science.
uncertainties: Credit is distributed across a large international accelerator community.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Photonic crystals established control of light through band structures, creating a fundamental and widely useful field of wave physics.
assessment.attribution: John and Yablonovitch provided seminal founding ideas and demonstrations, with Joannopoulos central to the theory and development of the field.
assessment.maturity: The physical principle is long established and has influenced optics, sensing, and nanophotonics.
uncertainties: The relative balance between conceptual proposals, theory, and experimental realization merits historical examination.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The quantum spin Hall effect and topological-insulator framework revealed a new robust organizing principle for electronic states of matter.
assessment.attribution: Kane and Mele supplied the seminal theoretical proposal, while Molenkamp led a defining experimental observation.
assessment.maturity: The phenomena have been reproduced broadly and integrated into a coherent theoretical and experimental field.
uncertainties: A full prize attribution must account for several closely related topological-insulator discoveries.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Magnetic skyrmions made topological spin textures experimentally tangible and created a rich route toward new magnetic functionality.
assessment.attribution: The nominees made major experimental contributions to establishing and imaging skyrmion phases and their properties.
assessment.maturity: The phenomena are well confirmed in diverse materials, though decisive technological utility remains less settled.
uncertainties: Foundational theoretical and earlier experimental contributions may complicate the proposed attribution.
The practical and device-level significance is still developing.
